title: EaseMuse
subtitle: AI-assisted recruiter workbench
noWorkspaceTitle: You're not in a workspace yet
noWorkspaceBody: EaseMuse workspaces are invitation-only. Ask an administrator at your agency to invite you, then open the link in the invitation email.

landing.headline: The recruiter does the recruiting. EaseMuse does the busywork.
landing.lead: One workbench for the whole search, from a client's brief to a signed offer. AI reads, organizes, compares and drafts when you ask, so you have more time for candidates and clients.

decide.title: You decide
decide.body: Who to source, shortlist, contact and submit is always the recruiter's call.

onRequest.title: Only when asked
onRequest.body: AI never searches, sends messages or rejects candidates on its own.

drafts.title: Drafts until approved
drafts.body: JD structure, match analysis, outreach and reports stay drafts until you edit and approve them.

score.title: Scores are a guide
score.body: A match score sets your review order. It never screens anyone out.

landing.portalNote: Hiring managers and candidates: use the invitation link your recruiter sent you.

workspaces.adminBody: Agencies, platform admins, usage and audit log
workspaces.wrongAccount: You're signed in as {email}. If your invitation went to a different address, sign in with that account.
